title: Autonomous Path-Planning Engine — Overview and definition
t: Autonomous Path-Planning Engine — Overview and definition
description: Finds feasible, near-optimal routes under obstacle and motion constraints.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Finds feasible, near-optimal routes under obstacle and motion constraints. A path-planning engine runs sampling-based (RRT*, PRM), search-based (A*, D*), and optimization (trajectory optimization) planners with kinodynamic constraints. Real implementations include OMPL, MoveIt, and Nav2 planners. It replans in real time around dynamic obstacles.
capabilities: Grid and lattice search with heuristics
